verdict.rationale: Lever documents Talent Fit, which uses AI-powered matching with customizable criteria to surface high-potential candidates, so the core AI matching capability exists. The evidence is a single marketing line, and nothing documents how the model works or what safeguards apply to automated decisions. Missing for 10: documentation of how Talent Fit's matching works, safeguards or human-review controls for automated decisions, bias/fairness or compliance disclosures, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, AI helps screen and match candidates against the role — with the vendor documenting how it works and what safeguards apply to automated decisions

citations.quote: Lever's Talent Fit uses AI-powered matching and customizable criteria to surface high-potential candidates quickly and easily.
